t13.label: Scrap Guitars for Parts
t13.description: Scrap guitars you don't want. Different guitars break down into different parts, so what you keep (and what you scrap) actually matters.

t25.label: Luthier: Guitar Parts & Upgrading
t25.description: Gear drops parts by rarity as you play, and the parts you scrap from guitars you don't want feed right back in. Spend matching parts at the Luthier to level up a guitar or effect and push its rarity higher.

t51.label: Gear Affects Fame Points
t51.description: The gear you're using changes how many Fame Points you earn per exercise type, so pick the right rig for the right drill.

t61.label: Sync Backing Track to Tablature
t61.description: Backing tracks for songs synced to the tab, so you can play along in time without hunting for the beat.

t79.label: Pedalboard Synergy
t79.description: Effects interact with each other, so pick and order your pedals carefully.

t89.label: Achievements Rework
t89.description: A full redo of achievements, plus new ones. Each one actually gives you something, not just a badge.

t107.label: Pedalboard Power Cap
t107.description: Your pedalboard has a power limit, so upgrade it if you want to run stronger effects.

t117.label: Gamification: Path/Skill Completion Rewards
t117.description: Finish a Journey, Roadmap, or Skill track and get a guitar or effect dropped as a reward.

t153.label: Player Progression System
t153.description: Level up from playing. Unlocks milestones, profile layouts, and which gear rarity you can equip.

t181.label: Configurable Dashboard
t181.description: Pick your own layout, widgets, and shortcuts for the main panel.

t191.label: Daily Unlock
t191.description: A time-based unlock that resets once a day, giving you a reason to come back.

t201.label: Configurable Guitarist Profile
t201.description: Show off what you want, how you want, using layouts unlocked through progression.

t229.label: Practice Mode
t229.description: Set goals per exercise and track your progress toward hitting them.

t244.label: Riff Cards
t244.description: Build a personal deck of riffs, songs and exercises that you can review with spaced repetition or play through freely anytime.

t262.label: Signature Guitars at the Luthier
t262.description: The Luthier stocks one-of-a-kind guitars you won't find anywhere else.

t346.label: Duels
t346.description: Challenge another player for Fame Points, like who can rack up more practice time before the clock runs out.

t415.label: New Practice Mode: Boss
t415.description: A new practice mode: Boss. Each boss sets a real requirement to clear. Hit the score and you level up, fall short and you're knocked out, no partial credit.

faq.title: Questions
faq.badge_answer: By matching the email on the donation to your account. If you paid from another address, just {{discord}} so I can attach it by hand. Tokens are spent in the {{panel}}.

0.q: Why does everyone get access for free?
0.a: Riff Quest stays free for everyone, full stop. When you support it you are not buying access for yourself, you are paying for development that the whole community gets to use. It works as a running total, not a subscription, so once a goal is reached it stays unlocked for good.

1.q: How long does it take to ship one goal?
1.a: It really depends on the goal. Something small can be ready in a couple of days, while a more demanding tier might take around two weeks. As a rule, the bigger the unlock the more time it needs, and I would rather take a few extra days than ship something half finished.

2.q: How does the supporter badge find my account?

3.q: What happens when every goal is reached?
3.a: The counter resets and a brand new roadmap goes up, built around the ideas you send in. Reaching the end is not a finish line, it is just the start of the next round of features.

hero.title: Help build Riff Quest
hero.subtitle: Riff Quest is free and made by one person. Your support pays the hosting bill first, and everything above it unlocks the next feature on the roadmap, for everyone.
hero.coffee_hint: A one-off coffee is enough. Nothing to sign up for, nothing to cancel.

thanks.title: Just want to say thanks?
thanks.body: Knowing Riff Quest is useful to you is already the good part. A coffee on top of that genuinely makes my day.

modal.body: Riff Quest is a one person project, free and built in the open. Your support covers the domain, hosting, and database first. Everything raised on top of that funds the roadmap: new exercises, gear, and features, unlocked tier by tier as the community funds them.
